text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You're so cool desu!
I was mesmerized by your splendid button handling!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Did you undergo training somewhere, desu?
What is your style, desu? What rank are you, desu?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm positively itching to inherit your soul and techniques, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I will follow you for life, so please teach me someday!
Promise me! Absolutely! P-R-O-M-I-S-E, DEEEEES!
